avoid_supplements.name: Growth hormone secretagogues (arginine, ornithine, GABA)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Direct antagonism of pegvisomant's therapeutic effect; may stimulate GH release and counteract receptor blockade
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; counsel patient on competing mechanisms of action

avoid_supplements.name: High-dose insulin sensitizers (berberine, chromium picolinate >200mcg/day)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Pegvisomant alters glucose metabolism; excessive insulin sensitization may increase hypoglycemia risk
avoid_supplements.action: Monitor blood glucose closely; coordinate with prescriber before use

caution_supplements.name: Vitamin D and calcium supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: GH antagonism may affect bone metabolism; adequate supplementation supports bone health during therapy
caution_supplements.action: Monitor bone density; ensure adequate intake but avoid excessive dosing

caution_supplements.name: Ginseng and adaptogenic herbs
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have mild GH-stimulating properties; clinical significance unclear at typical doses
caution_supplements.action: Use cautiously and monitor for reduced pegvisomant efficacy

caution_foods.name: High-glycemic refined carbohydrates
caution_foods.mechanism: Pegvisomant reduces GH-mediated metabolic effects; excess refined carbs may increase glucose dysregulation risk
caution_foods.action: Emphasize balanced macronutrient intake and monitor glucose control

monitoring_notes: Pegvisomant is a peptide with minimal hepatic metabolism and no major CYP interactions; monitor IGF-1 levels and glucose homeostasis regularly. Counsel on avoiding GH secretagogues and maintaining stable carbohydrate intake to optimize therapeutic efficacy and metabolic stability.
